subject: book-writer-mini-app
scope: What the Book Writer mini-app (U01-U18) adds to the Command Center, and the proof that it adds NO new Command Center endpoint and NO mission-control.db schema change.
truth_statement: The mini-app's ONLY Command Center touch is the U16 mc_board seam (mini-app/board/mc_seam.py), a thin, guaranteed non-raising wrapper over the skill's pre-existing vendored mc_board.py helper (53-book-writer/scripts/mc_board.py, a byte-for-byte vendored copy of 50-email-engine/mc_board.py). The seam opens a card on the existing marketing Kanban lane (department_slug=marketing, the RESOLVED real seeded slug from 23-ai-workforce-blueprint/skill-department-map.json) and moves that card through the existing task lifecycle. It adds nothing to the Command Center itself: no new route, no new handler, no schema migration.

lifecycle.begin_run: open ONE card on the marketing tasks lane (backlog -> in_progress). Per-run AND per-client: the mc_board idempotency key is derived from slug+title and the title carries the client_id, so no two clients collide.
lifecycle.card_advance: per-answer heartbeat: phase_id=intake-<qid>, status=in_progress. Review-NOT-done by construction.
lifecycle.complete_run: terminal producer move: card goes to `review`, NEVER `done`. review -> done is the independent QC scorer's exclusive move (THE BOARD CONTRACT).
lifecycle.block_run: gate-failure dead-end: card to `blocked` (visible on the board, never stranded at in_progress). reachable from any status in one hop; NEVER done.

command_center_touch.fail_soft: BINDING. A board outage / missing COMMAND_CENTER_URL / HTTP error is CAUGHT, logged to stderr, and the run CONTINUES. The board is a VIEW, never a gate. Every public seam function returns a value and NEVER raises. A board outage never loses the run's staging: the seam records a LOCAL phase -> board-receipt mapping (run/checkpoints/mc-board-seam.json) on EVERY call regardless of the board's answer, so a later reconcile can distinguish 'card landed' from 'board was down'.
command_center_touch.gate_receipts: The seam ALSO writes the assembler's gate-receipts file (run/checkpoints/gate-receipts.json, the run_book_writer.load_gate_receipts authority) in the EXACT shape {gate_id, approved, approved_by, approved_at}. APPEND-only; a human approval can never be self-attested.

no_new_cc_endpoint_proof.claim: The mini-app introduces NO new Command Center endpoint and NO mission-control.db schema change.
no_new_cc_endpoint_proof.how: The seam ONLY calls mc_board's pre-existing routes. Enumerated by source inspection (mini-app/board/mc_seam.py lines 259-362 + 53-book-writer/scripts/mc_board.py):
existing_routes_used: POST /api/tasks/ingest        (card_open: create the card, idempotent on idempotency_key)
GET/PATCH /api/tasks/{id}     (current_status + _move_once status writes; CC_STATUS_METHOD default PATCH; CC_STATUS_PATH_TEMPLATE default /api/tasks/{id})

route_inventory_audit.any_new_route_defined: none — mc_seam.py defines no HTTP route; it wraps mc_board.py's public functions (begin_run/card_advance/complete_run/block_run/record_gate_approval).
route_inventory_audit.any_schema_migration: none — the seam writes JSON receipt files under the run dir only; no mission-control.db table is touched.

no_new_cc_endpoint_proof.grep_proof: Run: /usr/bin/grep -n "api/" 53-book-writer/scripts/mc_board.py  -> every hit is one of the three existing routes above. Run: /usr/bin/grep -n "api/" 53-book-writer/mini-app/board/mc_seam.py  -> no api/ route is defined or called directly (the seam delegates to mc_board). Run: /usr/bin/grep -rn "mission-control.db" 53-book-writer/mini-app  -> zero hits (the mini-app's OWN KV key-shape contract, mini-app/worker/schema.sql, is the Cloudflare Workers "bw_bindings" namespace of the edge Worker — it is NOT the Command Center's mission-control.db and touches nothing on the Command Center side).
no_new_cc_endpoint_proof.endpoint_contract: Because the mini-app adds no endpoint and no schema, the root cc-compat.json contract is UNCHANGED: the skill rides the existing tasks/marketing Kanban lane (fail-soft). minVersion + pinnedTag require no bump for the mini-app.

no_anthropic_scan: mini-app contains no provider ids, no operator credentials, and no unresolved template tokens (the double-brace or dollar-paren shapes the write-back's placeholder lint refuses). prove_mini_app_isolation.py --self-test LINT case enforces the prover source; verify.sh section 7 runs the whole-tree anti-pattern scan. FICTIONAL fixtures only (FictitiousClientAlpha/Beta, loc_*_fake).
